title: CE31408: Soil-Structure Interaction
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

General soil-structure interaction problems. Contact pressures and soilstructure interaction for shallow foundations. Concept of subgrade modulus,
effects/parameters influencing subgrade modulus. Beams on elastic foundation
concept, introduction to the solution of beam problems. Curved failure
surfaces, their utility and analytical/graphical predictions from MohrCoulomb envelope and circle of stresses. Earth pressure distribution on walls.
Earth pressures on sheet piles, braced excavations. Design of anchors. Design
of supporting system of excavations. Arching in soils. Analysis of conduits.
Design and analysis of cofferdam. Laterally loaded piles. Reese and Matlock s
generalised solution. Non-linear load-deflection response. Uplift capacity of
piles and anchors.
